title: cloud: read whether manifest_json persists or parses dependency entries with optional (or AppManifest.dependencies), before the spec 18 retirement in #26401 reaches cloud
body:
Filed by the `domain:server` seat 1 on the maintainer's direct word for items that must go to cloud, verbatim: 「需要转给 cloud的，应该立 cloud 车道卡」 and 「开发中涉及 cloud 车道的，也应该转给 cloud」. Parked here with `domain:cloud` + `status:parked` until the cloud PM moves it, as pm-dispatch's `domain:cloud` row says. ⛔ Not a claim; this repository does not dispatch it.

**Origin:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#25792 item 6 (ADR-0141 D8 items 2 and 3), PR #26401. In `@objectstack/spec` 18 it retires two dependency spellings at once, as tombstones that refuse loudly:
- `PackageDependencySchema.optional` (`packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-version.zod.ts`): any authored value, `false` included, is now refused with a prescription.
- `AppManifestSchema.dependencies` (`packages/spec/src/system/app-install.zod.ts`).

The measured count was 0 readers and 0 writers outside `packages/spec` in this repository (`packages/`, `ui/`, `examples/`, `apps/`) and in HotCRM. `os package publish` uploads the compiled artifact as it is, so every snapshot measured here carries `dependencies` as the authored record (`{ id: range }`), never the array.

**What cloud must read:** the control-plane reader and writer of `sys_package_version.manifest_json` are not readable from this repository. Read them and answer two questions:
1. Does cloud persist, or parse through `PackageManifestSchema` / `PackageDependencySchema`, array entries that carry `optional` (`false` included)?
2. Does anything in cloud parse an `AppManifest` carrying `dependencies`?

**Done when:**
- Both answers are recorded on this card.
- If either is yes: before the framework bump that carries PR #26401 reaches cloud, cloud accepts the retired default as residue (`acceptRetiredDefaultResidue(PackageDependencySchema, { optional: false })`, the #12840 class ruled on cloud#1685) or stops writing it, so an existing row does not start refusing on read.
- If both are no: nothing more is owed.

This reading also serves the spec-lane card #25794 (D8 item 1, the record-to-array conversion), whose step 1 is the same `manifest_json` reading. Its array projection is now `packageId` and `versionRange` only (ADR-0141 D8 addendum in PR #26401).

Blocked-by: the `@objectstack/spec` release that carries PR #26401 (for the bump check). The two readings can be done now.
